unsubscribe.intro.go_live: You will no longer get an email when channels you follow go live. In-app and browser notifications are not affected.
unsubscribe.intro.governance: You will no longer get emails about new co-op votes and their results.
unsubscribe.intro.moved: You asked to be emailed once if a channel moves. You will not get that email.
unsubscribe.done.title: You are unsubscribed
unsubscribe.done.go_live: You will no longer get go-live emails. You can turn them back on in your notification settings.
unsubscribe.done.governance: You will no longer get co-op governance emails. You can turn them back on in your notification settings.
unsubscribe.done.moved: You will not get the moved-channel email. You can ask again from the channel page.
unsubscribe.invalid.title: This unsubscribe link does not work
unsubscribe.invalid.body: The link may be incomplete or out of date. Open it again from the email, or choose your emails in your notification settings.
unsubscribe.title.creator: Stop emails about your videos?
unsubscribe.intro.payout: You will no longer get an email when a payout is sent or held. Your studio still shows every payout.
unsubscribe.intro.creator: You will no longer get an email when a video of yours is ready. Your inbox still shows it.
unsubscribe.intro.weekly: You will no longer get the weekly “What you missed” email.
unsubscribe.done.payout: You will no longer get payout emails. You can turn them back on in your notification settings.
unsubscribe.done.creator: You will no longer get emails about your videos. You can turn them back on in your notification settings.
unsubscribe.done.weekly: You will no longer get the weekly email. You can turn it back on in your notification settings.
